name: The Fool
caption: TOMO
meaning: fresh start, spontaneity, and trusting the journey
essence: Tomo na ang desisyon mo. Kahit i-replay mo pa sa utak mo nang 48 times, same answer pa rin. Hindi ito teleseryeng may alternate ending.
guidance: Panindigan mo na. Kung pumalpak, at least ikaw ang director ng sarili mong kalat.
oneLiner: Nakapili ka na. Huwag ka nang magpa-survey sa buong barangay.

name: The Magician
caption: MANIFESTING LANG?
meaning: resourcefulness, skill, focus, and turning ideas into action
essence: Ang dami mong gustong simulan. Naka-save lahat sa bookmarks, drafts, at utak mo. Parang museum ng unfinished business.
guidance: Pumili ng isa at tapusin. Hindi counted as achievement ang paggawa ng magandang Canva cover.
oneLiner: May plano ka, may talent ka, may 37 tabs ka. Nasaan ang gawa?

name: The High Priestess
caption: MARITES RADAR
meaning: intuition, hidden knowledge, and the wisdom of silence
essence: May napansin kang kakaiba at gusto mong alamin ang buong story. Kalma, hindi ka NBI at hindi lahat ng seen ay may conspiracy.
guidance: Mag-observe muna bago mag-conclude. Hindi sapat ang isang emoji para gumawa ng 8-episode series.
oneLiner: May kutob ka. Kaso baka chismis lang na may matching background music.

name: The Empress
caption: ALAGA SA SARILI, SANA ALL
meaning: abundance, nurturing, creativity, and receiving
essence: May energy kang mag-alaga, magluto, mag-remind, at magdala ng buong mundo. Pero pag sarili mong tubig, nakakalimutan mo.
guidance: Kumain ka muna at magpahinga. Hindi ka 24/7 convenience store.
oneLiner: Ikaw ang taga-asikaso ng lahat. Ikaw, sino nag-aasikaso?

name: The Emperor
caption: BOSSING NG BARANGAY
meaning: structure, stability, authority, and healthy boundaries
essence: Gusto mong ikaw ang masusunod kahit sa pagpili ng ulam. Hindi lahat ng tao empleyado mo, kahit ikaw ang may hawak ng Google Sheet.
guidance: Mag-lead nang hindi nagiging HOA president ng buhay ng iba.
oneLiner: May rules ka. Sana sinusunod mo rin sarili mong rules.

name: The Hierophant
caption: TITA KNOWS ALL
meaning: tradition, learning, mentorship, and shared values
essence: May taong gustong magbigay ng payo kahit hindi mo tinatanong. Minsan may sense, minsan galing sa Facebook comment section.
guidance: Piliin ang useful. Hindi porke may edad, may access na sa tamang sagot.
oneLiner: May unsolicited advice na naman. Libre nga, unwanted naman.

name: The Lovers
caption: AYIE, SANA ALL
meaning: connection, alignment, meaningful choice, and values
essence: May connection na puwedeng cute. Pero kung ikaw lang ang nagbubuhat ng convo, hindi romance yan—customer service shift yan.
guidance: I-check kung may effort sa magkabilang side. Hindi sapat ang heart react para maging jowa.
oneLiner: May kilig. Pero may ambag ba o puro good morning?

name: The Chariot
caption: HATAW KUNG HATAW
meaning: determination, momentum, discipline, and directed will
essence: May lakas kang gumalaw at tapusin ang ganap. Sana hindi ka nagmamadali dahil may nakita kang ibang tao na nag-success post.
guidance: Diretso sa goal. Huwag gawing karera ang buhay ng kapitbahay.
oneLiner: Ang bilis mong umusad. May destination ba o nagmamadali ka lang?

name: Strength
caption: MATIBAY PA SA WIFI
meaning: inner courage, patience, compassion, and self-mastery
essence: May pasensya ka na parang unlimited data. Pero hindi ibig sabihin kailangan mong tiisin lahat ng kalokohan.
guidance: Maging matatag, pero marunong ding mag-block. Hindi medalya ang pagiging laging available.
oneLiner: Kahit ilang beses kang ma-disappoint, bumabangon ka pa rin. Aba, limited edition.

name: The Hermit
caption: DO NOT DISTURB
meaning: reflection, solitude, inner guidance, and seeking wisdom
essence: Gusto mo ng tahimik, walang tawag, walang tanong, walang 'uy gising ka?' Hindi ka suplada; ayaw mo lang ng meeting na walang agenda.
guidance: Magpahinga nang walang guilt. Hindi kailangang mag-explain ng leave of absence sa GC.
oneLiner: Hindi ka nawawala. Naka-lowbat ka lang sa mga tao.

name: Wheel of Fortune
caption: SANA ALL MAY PLOT TWIST
meaning: cycles, change, turning points, and changing circumstances
essence: May biglang pagbabago sa schedule, plano, o budget. Parang delivery rider na tumawag: nasa labas na raw, pero wala ka namang inorder.
guidance: Mag-adjust. Huwag muna mag-post ng 'never again' habang hindi pa tapos ang araw.
oneLiner: Akala mo ordinaryong araw. Biglang may ganap na naman si universe.

name: Justice
caption: RESIBO O FAKE NEWS
meaning: fairness, truth, accountability, and balanced decisions
essence: May kailangang linawin at may facts na dapat makita. Hindi puwedeng puro sabi-sabi at screenshot na cropped.
guidance: I-check ang details. Kung mali ka, amin. Kung sila ang mali, huwag kang mag-sorry out of habit.
oneLiner: May resibo ba? Kasi ayaw na natin sa trust me bro.

name: The Hanged Man
caption: BUFFERING ANG BUHAY
meaning: pause, surrender, patience, and a new perspective
essence: May bagay na hindi umuusad kahit ilang refresh mo na. Hindi lahat nadadaan sa restart ng router, mhie.
guidance: Hintayin ang tamang timing pero gumawa ng kaya mong gawin. Huwag lang titigan ang loading circle.
oneLiner: Naka-99% ka na. Bakit ayaw mag-load?

name: Death
caption: EX NA, WAG I-RENEW
meaning: endings, transformation, release, and renewal
essence: May bagay na dapat nang i-end. Pero ikaw, nag-iisip pa ng comeback episode kahit cancelled na ang show.
guidance: I-close ang tab. Hindi lahat ng bumabalik deserve ng reactivation.
oneLiner: Tapos na ang contract. Bakit nag-aappeal ka pa?

name: Temperance
caption: KALMA LANG, TEH
meaning: moderation, patience, integration, and healing
essence: Ang daming ganap at lahat gusto ikaw ang sumalo. Parang ikaw lang ang may kamay sa buong opisina.
guidance: Unahin ang importante. Hindi ka octopus na may unlimited leave credits.
oneLiner: Hindi lahat urgent. Yung iba, marunong lang mag-caps lock.

name: The Devil
caption: RED FLAG FESTIVAL
meaning: attachment, temptation, unhealthy patterns, and reclaiming agency
essence: May habit o tao na alam mong sakit sa ulo pero binabalikan mo. Parang app na laging nagka-crash pero ayaw mong i-uninstall.
guidance: I-unfollow ang source ng stress. Hindi ka required magpa-loyalty card sa katangahan.
oneLiner: May warning signs na, nagdala ka pa ng confetti.

name: The Tower
caption: AYAN NA, GUMUHO NA
meaning: sudden change, revelation, disruption, and rebuilding
essence: May planong biglang nagkalasog-lasog. At least hindi mo na kailangang mag-maintain ng illusion na ikaw lang ang may alam.
guidance: Maglinis ng kalat. Huwag nang mag-arkila ulit ng space sa delusion.
oneLiner: Yung pinanghahawakan mong kasinungalingan, nag-blue screen.

name: The Star
caption: GLOWING ANG ACcla
meaning: hope, renewal, inspiration, and quiet faith
essence: May konting liwanag sa araw mo. Puwedeng small win, magandang balita, o simpleng hindi ka na inaway ng printer.
guidance: I-enjoy mo. Huwag hanapan ng problema ang araw na maayos naman.
oneLiner: May good news. Bawal kontrahin ng 'wala lang yun'.

name: The Moon
caption: OVERTHINKING OLYMPICS
meaning: uncertainty, dreams, intuition, and unclear information
essence: May 15 possible meanings ang isang 'okay'. May director's cut pa ang utak mo kahit wala namang pelikula.
guidance: Magtanong kung kailangan. Huwag gumawa ng season finale dahil lang late mag-reply.
oneLiner: Gold medal ka na naman sa paggawa ng scenario na hindi nangyari.

name: The Sun
caption: GOOD VIBES LANG, MAY RESIBO
meaning: joy, clarity, confidence, and vitality
essence: May magandang ganap, at puwede kang maging masaya nang hindi naghihintay ng kapalit na problema.
guidance: I-celebrate. Huwag mong i-jinx sa kakasabi ng 'parang may mangyayaring masama'.
oneLiner: Sa wakas, may araw na hindi ka pinagtripan ng tadhana.

name: Judgement
caption: ULITIN ANG LESSON?
meaning: awakening, reflection, reckoning, and a new call
essence: Parehong problema, bagong pangalan lang. Parang sequel na hindi naman hiniling ng audience.
guidance: Baguhin ang ginagawa mo. Hindi puwedeng same script tapos magtataka ka sa ending.
oneLiner: Ilang beses na itong tinuro. May attendance ka ba?

name: The World
caption: LEVEL UP, MAY PA-CONGRATS
meaning: completion, integration, accomplishment, and wholeness
essence: May milestone ka nang naabot. Kahit ilang beses kang muntik mag-resign sa buhay, nakaabot ka rin sa finish line.
guidance: Mag-celebrate. Deserve mo ang pahinga at isang magandang merienda.
oneLiner: Natapos mo rin. Pwede nang mag-flex nang konti.

name: Ace of Wands
caption: APOY NA WALANG POSPORO
meaning: inspiration, creative spark, and a new beginning
essence: May excitement ka sa bagong plano. Pero kung hanggang notes app lang, baka fan fiction pa lang yan.
guidance: Gawin ang unang step. Hindi kailangan ng ribbon-cutting para magsimula.
oneLiner: Ang dami mong idea. Nasaan ang unang galaw?

name: Two of Wands
caption: PLANNING COMMITTEE
meaning: planning, future vision, and choosing a direction
essence: Pinag-iisipan mo pa ang options habang tumatagal, dumadami ang screenshots at nababawasan ang oras.
guidance: Pumili ng isa bago ka maubusan ng storage sa kakasave ng inspiration.
oneLiner: May vision board ka na. May actual schedule ba?

name: Three of Wands
caption: NASAAN NA ANG UPDATE?
meaning: expansion, foresight, and progress beyond your comfort zone
essence: May progress pero kailangan ng follow-through. Hindi sapat ang announcement na 'soon' since 2023.
guidance: Mag-follow up at kumilos. Hindi ka brand na puro teaser.
oneLiner: May nasimulan ka na. Huwag iwan sa seen ang sarili mong goal.

name: Four of Wands
caption: HANDANG MAGPA-PARTY
meaning: celebration, belonging, and a stable foundation
essence: May maliit o malaking win na deserve ng konting saya. Hindi lahat kailangan hintaying maging milyonaryo bago maghanda.
guidance: I-celebrate ang progress. Bawal ang inggit sa sariling achievement.
oneLiner: May dahilan para mag-celebrate. Kahit instant noodles, lagyan ng egg.

name: Five of Wands
caption: GC WARS
meaning: competition, friction, and clashing priorities
essence: May banggaan ng ego at opinions. Ang meeting naging WWE at wala namang prize.
guidance: Piliin ang laban. Hindi lahat ng chat kailangan ng reply na may attachment.
oneLiner: Lahat may opinion. Pati taong hindi kasama sa usapan.

name: Six of Wands
caption: PALAKPAKAN NAMAN DIYAN
meaning: victory, public recognition, and earned confidence
essence: May recognition na puwedeng dumating dahil may ginawa kang maayos. Hindi ka nagkataong nandiyan lang.
guidance: Tanggapin ang compliment. Hindi required mag-reply ng 'swerte lang'.
oneLiner: May achievement ka. Huwag mong i-downplay na parang accidental lang.

name: Seven of Wands
caption: DEFENSE MODE
meaning: defending your position, resilience, and healthy boundaries
essence: May kailangan kang ipaglaban, pero hindi lahat ng side comment ay attack sa pagkatao mo.
guidance: Magsalita kung kailangan. Huwag ubusin ang energy sa mga taong hobby ang mang-asar.
oneLiner: Hindi ka punching bag ng group chat.

name: Eight of Wands
caption: NOTIFICATION OVERLOAD
meaning: swift movement, momentum, and fast communication
essence: May updates at ganap na sabay-sabay. Lahat urgent daw, pero wala namang nagdala ng kape.
guidance: Isa-isahin. Hindi ka customer support ng buong planeta.
oneLiner: Sunod-sunod ang message. Wala bang mute button ang buhay?

name: Nine of Wands
caption: LAST BARANGAY STANDING
meaning: perseverance, guarded hope, and the final stretch
essence: Marami ka nang nalampasan. Pero hindi mo kailangang gawing personality ang pagiging laging matatag.
guidance: Magpahinga. Hindi ka security guard na kailangang gising buong gabi.
oneLiner: Pagod ka na, pero naka-duty ka pa rin sa pagiging strong.

name: Ten of Wands
caption: IKAW NA NAMAN?
meaning: burden, responsibility, and the need to release excess weight
essence: Sobra na ang tasks mo. May mga taong sanay na ikaw ang sasalo, parang ikaw ang official taga-linis ng kalat.
guidance: Mag-delegate. Hindi ka one-person production company.
oneLiner: Bakit ikaw ang taga-buhat? May braso rin sila.

name: Page of Wands
caption: IDEA LANG MUNA, TEH
meaning: enthusiasm, exploration, and a creative beginning
essence: May bagong trip kang gustong subukan. Excited ka ngayon, pero baka bukas may bago ka nang obsession.
guidance: Subukan mo muna bago bumili ng complete starter kit.
oneLiner: New hobby unlocked. Sana tumagal hanggang Friday.

name: Knight of Wands
caption: GO LANG NANG GO
meaning: bold action, adventure, and restless ambition
essence: Mabilis kang kumilos kapag may gusto ka. Minsan nauuna ang paa bago ang utak.
guidance: Enjoy the adventure, pero basahin muna ang fine print at terms.
oneLiner: Ang tapang ng entrance. Sana may exit plan din.

name: Queen of Wands
caption: MAIN CHARACTER SA KANTO
meaning: confidence, magnetism, and creative leadership
essence: Napapansin ka kahit hindi ka nag-i-effort. Pero huwag gawing competition ang bawat reunion.
guidance: Mag-shine ka. Bigyan din ng chance ang iba na magkwento.
oneLiner: May dating ka. Hindi kailangang agawan lahat ng spotlight.

name: King of Wands
caption: BOSS NA MAY ALL CAPS
meaning: vision, entrepreneurship, and inspiring leadership
essence: Gusto mong maayos ang lahat, pero minsan tunog announcement ka na sa barangay hall.
guidance: Magbigay ng malinaw na direction nang hindi nang-i-intimidate.
oneLiner: May leadership potential. Huwag lang gawing memo ang bawat sermon.

name: Ace of Cups
caption: KILIG NA MAY KULANG
meaning: emotional openness, compassion, and a fresh connection
essence: May bagong emotional ganap. Cute ang simula, pero huwag muna mag-order ng couple shirt.
guidance: Enjoy the kilig. I-check muna kung marunong mag-effort.
oneLiner: May kilig pero wala pang proof of purchase.

name: Two of Cups
caption: SANA PAREHO ANG EFFORT
meaning: mutual attraction, partnership, and emotional reciprocity
essence: May connection na puwedeng maging cute kung pareho kayong present. Hindi puwedeng ikaw lang ang nag-iisip ng date.
guidance: Sabihin ang gusto mo. Kung ikaw lang ang gumagalaw, magpahinga ka muna.
oneLiner: Two-way street dapat. Hindi ka nag-iisang jeepney route.

name: Three of Cups
caption: TROPA MO, TROPA KO
meaning: friendship, celebration, and joyful community
essence: Friends and celebration ang tema. May isang friend na laging late pero unang kumain.
guidance: Mag-enjoy kasama ang tunay na tropa. Iwasan ang group photo na may silent war.
oneLiner: May ganap, may tawanan, may isang nawawala sa ambagan.

name: Four of Cups
caption: WALA SA MOOD ANG REYNA
meaning: apathy, contemplation, and overlooked opportunities
essence: May offer o invite pero hindi ka interesado. At hindi mo kailangang piliting maging excited para lang hindi sila ma-offend.
guidance: Sabihin nang maayos na pass muna. Hindi ka required mag-attend ng lahat.
oneLiner: Hindi ka masungit. Baka sawa ka lang sa paulit-ulit na tanong.

name: Five of Cups
caption: SAD GIRL SA GILID
meaning: disappointment, grief, and the possibility of emotional recovery
essence: May hindi natuloy kaya badtrip ka. Valid yan, pero huwag gawing permanent address ang disappointment.
guidance: Umiyak kung kailangan. Tapos kain, ligo, tulog. Bukas ulit ang chismis.
oneLiner: May tampo. May luha. May playlist na pang-3AM.

name: Six of Cups
caption: THROWBACK NA NAMAN?
meaning: nostalgia, kindness, and memories from the past
essence: May lumang tao o alaala na sumingit sa feed mo. Hindi ibig sabihin kailangan mong mag-chat ng 'kumusta?'
guidance: I-enjoy ang nostalgia. Huwag i-reinstall ang app na nag-crash na dati.
oneLiner: Nagparamdam ang past. Baka memory lang, hindi invitation.

name: Seven of Cups
caption: PILI KA, TEH
meaning: many possibilities, fantasy, and the need for discernment
essence: May options kang pinag-iisipan. Sa kakapili, baka maubusan ka ng oras at gutom ka pa rin.
guidance: Tingnan ang actual, hindi yung imaginary version na ginawa mo sa utak.
oneLiner: Ang daming choices, parang menu na walang presyo.

name: Eight of Cups
caption: EXIT NA ANG ATING BESHY
meaning: walking away, emotional searching, and seeking deeper fulfillment
essence: May bagay kang gustong iwan kahit may attachment. Hindi lahat ng mahal mo, kailangan mong i-maintain.
guidance: Umalis kung kailangan. Huwag nang mag-render ng 30 days sa kalbaryo.
oneLiner: May feelings pa pero wala nang customer service.

name: Nine of Cups
caption: DESERVE KO TO
meaning: contentment, wishes fulfilled, and emotional satisfaction
essence: May personal win na puwedeng i-enjoy. Baka finally may dumating na hindi kailangan habulin.
guidance: I-celebrate. Treat yourself, pero silipin muna ang bank balance.
oneLiner: May wish na natupad. Huwag mo nang hanapan ng plot twist.

name: Ten of Cups
caption: FAMILY REUNION ENERGY
meaning: lasting happiness, emotional harmony, and family connection
essence: May saya sa mga taong komportable kang kasama. Hindi kailangan perfect ang setup para maging masaya.
guidance: Piliin ang mga taong safe kang maging ikaw. Iwas sa tita na may questionnaire.
oneLiner: May happy ending. Sana walang magtanong kung kailan ka mag-aasawa.

name: Page of Cups
caption: SORRY NA, PROMISE
meaning: romance, sensitivity, and a heartfelt message
essence: May sweet message o sorry na puwedeng dumating. Pero hindi magic word ang sorry para mabura ang kalat.
guidance: Tingnan ang actions. Hindi collectible ang apology.
oneLiner: Apology accepted? Wait, nasaan ang pagbabago?

name: Knight of Cups
caption: ROMCOM NA WALANG BUDGET
meaning: romantic pursuit, charm, and following the heart
essence: May taong marunong sa sweet gestures. Sana marunong din mag-reply kapag kailangan mo.
guidance: Kilig responsibly. Huwag ibigay ang buong puso sa free trial.
oneLiner: Romantic ang message. Sana pati consistency kasama sa package.

name: Queen of Cups
caption: LIBRENG THERAPIST
meaning: empathy, intuition, and compassionate understanding
essence: Ikaw ang takbuhan ng tropa. May emotional support ka sa lahat, pero wala kang sariling help desk.
guidance: Magtakda ng limit. Hindi ka hotline na walang closing time.
oneLiner: Lahat may problema sa'yo lumalapit. Ikaw, kanino?

name: King of Cups
caption: EMOTIONALLY PRESENT, SANA ALL
meaning: emotional balance, wisdom, and steady compassion
essence: Kaya mong maging kalmado sa gulo. Pero minsan kailangan mo ring sabihin na nasasaktan ka.
guidance: Magsalita nang diretso. Hindi mind reader ang kausap mo.
oneLiner: May feelings ka. I-announce mo rin, hindi puro poker face.

name: Ace of Swords
caption: DIRETSO NA, WALANG INTRO
meaning: clarity, truth, and a decisive new idea
essence: May malinaw na impormasyon o realization. Wala nang paligoy-ligoy at pa-mysterious.
guidance: Sabihin ang totoo nang walang unnecessary insult. Hindi ito roast battle.
oneLiner: May truth na kailangang sabihin. Bawal na ang cryptic story.

name: Two of Swords
caption: AYAW PUMILI?
meaning: indecision, stalemate, and blocked communication
essence: May choice kang iniiwasan. Habang tumatagal, lalo lang humahaba ang pila ng problema.
guidance: Kunin ang facts at pumili. Hindi ka maghihintay ng poll results mula sa universe.
oneLiner: Hindi pagdedesisyon ang pag-scroll hanggang ma-lowbat.

name: Three of Swords
caption: OUCH, MAY RESIBO
meaning: heartbreak, painful truth, and emotional separation
essence: May realization na hindi mo gustong marinig. Parang nakita mo ang screenshot na hindi dapat na-forward.
guidance: Tanggapin ang nangyari. Iiyak kung kailangan, pero huwag mag-beg sa obvious.
oneLiner: Masakit ang katotohanan. Pero mas nakakahiya ang denial.

name: Four of Swords
caption: PAHINGA MUNA, MHIE
meaning: rest, recovery, and mental stillness
essence: Kailangan mo ng downtime. Pati utak mo gusto nang mag-file ng leave.
guidance: I-mute ang notifications. Matulog. Hindi ka mawawalan ng plot kung magpahinga.
oneLiner: Walang medalya sa pagod na pagod ka na pero online pa rin.

name: Five of Swords
caption: ARGUMENT CHAMPION
meaning: hollow victory, tension, and conflict driven by ego
essence: May conflict na gustong palakihin ng ego. Ang prize: stress at screenshot sa GC.
guidance: Tanungin kung worth it. Minsan ang best reply ay seen.
oneLiner: Nanalo ka sa debate. Nawala naman ang buong hapon mo.

name: Six of Swords
caption: LIPAT NA TAYO
meaning: transition, moving on, and calmer waters
essence: May transition na hindi instant, pero mas okay kaysa manatili sa gulo.
guidance: Dalhin ang charger at lessons. Iwan ang taong laging lowbat ang ambag.
oneLiner: Bagong environment, same ikaw. Sana less kalat na.

name: Seven of Swords
caption: SECRET AGENT ANG PEG
meaning: secrecy, strategy, and the risk of deception
essence: May impormasyon na kulang o may taong hindi transparent. Huwag agad magtiwala sa kwentong putol-putol.
guidance: Mag-verify. Hindi lahat ng may secret ay may plot twist na worth it.
oneLiner: May hindi sinasabi. Ikaw naman, nag-iimbestiga na parang teleserye.

name: Eight of Swords
caption: SARILI MONG HARANG
meaning: restriction, self-doubt, and a way out through perspective
essence: Pakiramdam mo stuck ka, pero baka takot lang ang naglagay ng maraming imaginary rules.
guidance: Subukan ang isang maliit na move. Hindi kailangang solved lahat bago ka umusad.
oneLiner: May pinto naman. Ikaw lang ang nakikipag-negotiate sa doorknob.

name: Nine of Swords
caption: 3AM THOUGHTS
meaning: anxiety, worry, and mental overload
essence: Ang utak mo may night shift. Gumagawa ng scenario habang ang totoong tao mahimbing ang tulog.
guidance: Ilagay sa notes at balikan bukas. Huwag magdesisyon habang antok at gutom.
oneLiner: Nagpupuyat ka para sa problemang tulog na ang may gawa.

name: Ten of Swords
caption: BLOCKED NA ANG ENDING
meaning: painful ending, betrayal, and the chance to begin again
essence: May ending na hindi na mababago. Kahit i-refresh mo ang chat, wala nang bagong reply.
guidance: Move on sa sariling pace. Huwag magpadala ng 'last message' kada linggo.
oneLiner: Tapos na ang episode. Wala nang post-credit scene.

name: Page of Swords
caption: FBI INTERN
meaning: curiosity, observation, and learning through questions
essence: May bagong impormasyon na gustong alamin. Baka tanong lang, baka nag-open ka na ng 12 tabs.
guidance: Magtanong nang maayos. Hindi kailangan ng background check sa lahat.
oneLiner: Curious ka lang daw. Pero alam mo pati pangalan ng aso niya.

name: Knight of Swords
caption: MABILIS ANG DALIRI
meaning: ambition, swift action, and blunt communication
essence: Mabilis ang reaction mo. Minsan tama, minsan kailangan ng unsend button.
guidance: Huminga muna bago mag-reply. Hindi lahat ng thought kailangang i-publish.
oneLiner: Na-send mo na bago mo pa na-proofread. Ay wow.

name: Queen of Swords
caption: MATARAY PERO MAY POINT
meaning: discernment, independence, and clear boundaries
essence: Kita mo ang inconsistency at ayaw mong magpaloko. Good. Pero puwede ring maging clear nang hindi nananaksak.
guidance: Diretso pero hindi cruel. Hindi kailangan manakit para maintindihan.
oneLiner: Tama ka nga. Kaso bakit parang may kasamang subpoena?

name: King of Swords
caption: AKO ANG MAY LAST WORD
meaning: intellectual authority, fairness, and strategic judgment
essence: May logic at facts ka. Pero minsan ang goal ay ayusin ang problema, hindi manalo sa barangay debate.
guidance: Gamitin ang utak. I-save ang energy sa laban na may silbi.
oneLiner: Hindi lahat ng usapan kailangan ikaw ang may closing statement.

name: Ace of Pentacles
caption: SWELDO, NASAN KA?
meaning: a tangible opportunity, prosperity, and a grounded new start
essence: May practical chance na puwedeng pagkakitaan. Pero may gastos ding gustong sumingit.
guidance: Basahin ang terms. Huwag gumastos ng perang hindi pa pumapasok.
oneLiner: May opportunity kumita. Sana hindi checkout ang unang destination.

name: Two of Pentacles
caption: MULTITASKING NA WALANG SAHOD
meaning: adaptability, juggling priorities, and financial balance
essence: May bills, errands, trabaho, at kung anu-ano. Parang naka-open ang 28 apps sa utak mo.
guidance: Gumawa ng listahan. Unahin ang may deadline, hindi ang pinakamalakas mangulit.
oneLiner: Sabay-sabay lahat. Ikaw lang ang hindi nasasabay sa pahinga.

name: Three of Pentacles
caption: TEAMWORK SANA ALL
meaning: teamwork, craftsmanship, and recognition for skill
essence: May project na mas gagaan kung may ambag ang lahat. Pero may isang laging naka-available sa seen zone.
guidance: Hatiin ang trabaho. Hindi ka group project martyr.
oneLiner: May team pero ikaw ang buong department.

name: Four of Pentacles
caption: IPON O KURIPOT?
meaning: saving, control, and fear of losing stability
essence: May concern ka sa security at gastos. Okay mag-ipon, pero huwag gawing bawal ang lahat ng saya.
guidance: Mag-budget. Magtabi para sa bills at konting kape na hindi kailangang ipagdasal.
oneLiner: Gusto mong safe ang pera. Pati sarili mong saya naka-lock.

name: Five of Pentacles
caption: WALANG BUDGET, MAY DIGNIDAD
meaning: financial hardship, isolation, and seeking support
essence: May gastos o pressure na mabigat. Hindi ka less dahil hindi ka makasabay sa lifestyle ng iba.
guidance: Humingi ng tulong kung kailangan. Iwas muna sa budol at comparison.
oneLiner: Kapos ang pera, hindi ang pagkatao mo.

name: Six of Pentacles
caption: GCASH ANG PEG?
meaning: generosity, shared resources, and fair exchange
essence: May usapang tulungan at resources. Baka ikaw ang laging nagbibigay o may taong hindi marunong mag-thank you.
guidance: Linawin ang usapan. Hindi ka ATM na may feelings.
oneLiner: Give and take daw. Bakit ikaw lang ang may ambag?

name: Seven of Pentacles
caption: TANIM NG TANIM
meaning: patience, long-term investment, and evaluating progress
essence: May effort na hindi pa nagbubunga. Hindi ibig sabihin walang nangyayari—pero baka kailangan ding baguhin ang diskarte.
guidance: Check progress. Huwag hukayin ang halaman kada umaga.
oneLiner: Gusto mo nang anihin kahit kahapon ka lang nagtanim.

name: Eight of Pentacles
caption: TUTORIAL COLLECTOR
meaning: apprenticeship, diligence, and mastery through repetition
essence: May skill kang gustong matutunan. Ang dami mong resources, pero baka mas kabisado mo na ang thumbnail kaysa lesson.
guidance: Pumili ng isang tutorial at tapusin. Practice, hindi save.
oneLiner: May 86 saved tutorials. Ilan ang sinubukan mo?

name: Nine of Pentacles
caption: DESERVE ANG SARILING SWELDO
meaning: self-sufficiency, earned comfort, and personal success
essence: May independence at comfort na galing sa sariling effort. Deserve mong ma-enjoy nang responsable.
guidance: Mag-enjoy sa budget. Hindi kailangan i-explain ang maliit na reward.
oneLiner: Pinaghirapan mo yan. Huwag puro guilt ang checkout.

name: Ten of Pentacles
caption: FUTURE-PROOF ANG WALLET
meaning: legacy, long-term wealth, and family stability
essence: May choices na may epekto sa long-term security. Hindi puro instant gratification ang laban.
guidance: Magtabi para sa future. Kahit maliit, basta hindi puro wishful thinking.
oneLiner: Hindi lang pang-weekend ang pera, bes.

name: Page of Pentacles
caption: BEGINNER PA LANG, OA KA NA
meaning: study, practical ambition, and a new financial skill
essence: May bagong skill o opportunity na nagsisimula. Hindi puwedeng expert agad pagkatapos ng isang YouTube video.
guidance: Matuto step by step. Huwag ikumpara ang Day 1 mo sa 10-year career ng iba.
charotName: BEGINNER PA LANG, OA KA NA
oneLiner: Hindi ka failure. Kaka-download mo pa lang ng app.

name: Knight of Pentacles
caption: SLOW BUT MAY SAHOD
meaning: reliability, patience, and consistent effort
essence: May routine na mabagal pero maaasahan. Hindi glamorous, pero may progress.
guidance: Tuloy lang. Consistency ang peg, hindi biglang viral tapos ghost.
oneLiner: Hindi mabilis, pero hindi rin puro salita.

name: Queen of Pentacles
caption: ALAGA SA BUDGET
meaning: practical care, resourcefulness, and grounded abundance
essence: Kaya mong ayusin ang bahay, budget, at buhay ng iba. Huwag kalimutang may sarili ka ring needs.
guidance: Magtabi para sa sarili. Hindi lahat ng pera mo may ibang pangalan.
oneLiner: May diskarte ka sa pera. Sana pati sa pag-aalaga sa sarili.

name: King of Pentacles
caption: MAYAMAN SA DISKARTE
meaning: financial leadership, prosperity, and responsible stewardship
essence: May chance kang bumuo ng stable na setup. Hindi kailangang magpanggap na mayaman para maging successful.
guidance: Planuhin ang pera at panindigan ang budget. Huwag mag-flex ng utang.
oneLiner: Abundance is cute. Bayad muna ng bills, accla.
